meta.note: Counts are frame sizes, not evidence counts. A failed probe is recorded as an error and is NOT a zero.

exposure_all.purpose: the whole exposure cloud, any outcome
exposure_all.query: ((coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") OR ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang) OR ("household formation" OR "independent household" OR "multigenerational household"))

coreside_only.query: (coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home")

leaving_only.query: ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang)

exposure_x_fertility.purpose: PRIMARY cell frame: exposure with a fertility outcome
exposure_x_fertility.query: ((coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") OR ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang) OR ("household formation" OR "independent household" OR "multigenerational household")) AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate")

exposure_x_union.purpose: link-1 cell: exposure with a union outcome only
exposure_x_union.query: ((coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") OR ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang) OR ("household formation" OR "independent household" OR "multigenerational household")) AND ("union formation" OR "partnership formation" OR marriage OR cohabitation)

exposure_x_fert_x_ident.query: ((coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") OR ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang) OR ("household formation" OR "independent household" OR "multigenerational household")) AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate") AND (instrument OR "natural experiment" OR "difference-in-differences" OR experimental OR "regression discontinuity" OR causal OR exogenous)

exposure_x_fert_x_elder.purpose: the eldercare homonym inside the primary frame
exposure_x_fert_x_elder.query: ((coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") OR ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang) OR ("household formation" OR "independent household" OR "multigenerational household")) AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate") AND (elderly OR caregiving OR "older parents" OR "long-term care" OR dementia OR filial)

coreside_x_fert.query: (coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate")

coreside_x_fert_x_elder.purpose: eldercare share of the co-residence sub-cloud
coreside_x_fert_x_elder.query: (coresidence OR "co-residence" OR coresiding OR coresident OR "living with parents" OR "living at home" OR "parental home") AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate") AND (elderly OR caregiving OR "older parents" OR "long-term care" OR dementia OR filial)

leaving_x_fert.query: ("leaving home" OR "leaving the parental home" OR "home leaving" OR "nest leaving" OR "residential independence" OR boomerang) AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate")

hhform_x_fert.query: ("household formation" OR "independent household" OR "multigenerational household") AND (fertility OR childbearing OR "first birth" OR parenthood OR "birth rate")
